acceptance: A valid request is dispatched by the pipeline, and its result reaches the lineage index of the requester
An unreasonable request is refused with a recorded reason
A request from an agent that a request dispatched is refused past the chain depth cap, and a request past the cycle cap is refused
A direct evolve agent run from the cell is still refused
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §7.2 and §19 updated

consumed.resolution: built: agentrequest channel, dispatch-phase-agent catalog action, policy isolation.dispatch_requests, inprocess_subagents manifest capability (PR stacked on #1211)

fix: Add the declared output requests/dispatch-<n>.json (target role, reason, inputs, expected output) with a schema. Validate it in Go: the schema, the allowed roles, a cap on requests for each cycle and a cap on the depth of a chain of requests (proposed policy key isolation.dispatch_requests). Add the catalog action 'dispatch phase agent' to the ADR-0155 action catalog, so the orchestrator agent judges each request. On approval the pipeline dispatches the agent and adds its result to the lineage index of the requester. A refusal records its reason. Add the manifest capability inprocess_subagents.
source: console, 2026-10-26, operator refinement of I-3 (ADR-0154 amendment); see docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §7.2
summary: The operator refined I-3 on 2026-10-26: a CLI can run its own subagents in its own CLI process, with no new exec of an LLM binary, but another phase agent needs a request back to the loop. Today a cell has no channel to ask; the only paths are the denied exec and the refused evolve dispatch verbs. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §7.2, §19; ADR-0154 I-3 (amended 2026-10-26); ADR-0155. Inside its own harness an agent may start any subagent type and any model of its family (operator, 2026-10-26); the pipeline sets only the boundary.
title: LLM isolation: a phase agent asks for another phase agent through a typed dispatch request that the pipeline validates and the orchestrator judges
